summary: Tested Valkeyry-Config auth/admin/tools flow against the FastAPI mock at preview URL. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed covering /api/v1/auth/{config,login,me,logout}, full /api/v1/admin/tenants CRUD, /api/v1/admin/users + writer-role gating (bob 403 on admin), /api/v1/tools/convert/{csv,xlsx=501,dmn}, static page assets. Frontend: login (admin/admin), redirect-to-admin, tenants/users tables, add-tenant (qa) and add-user (alice_test) UI flows, /tools.html CSV conversion (returned JSON tables with rows), unauthenticated / → /login.html gate, top-bar nav-admin-link/nav-tools-link/logout-btn visible for admin, bad-credentials error 'Bad credentials' surfaced. One UI bug found: the logout-btn on /index does not fire vk.logout().

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the logout button on / (index) does NOT clear vk.auth.v1 from localStorage and does NOT navigate to /login.html. Confirmed: pre-logout vk.auth.v1 length=381, post-logout still present; URL stays on /. The tenant 'Connect to a tenant' modal opens on first index load and its backdrop appears to be intercepting clicks (Playwright clicked with force=true and HTMX nav-admin-link/nav-tools-link work, but logout-btn fires nothing). Either the click handler is not bound (e.g. bound before bootApp() injects the top-bar) or z-index on the modal backdrop is above the top-bar. Direct test via console: clicking [data-testid=logout-btn] does not redirect. Calling vk.logout() in DevTools works correctly (clears storage + redirects), so the wiring is the gap.

issues: cdn.tailwindcss.com used at runtime; Tailwind itself warns 'should not be used in production'. Fine for the preview but flag for the Java build.

action_items: Fix logout-btn wiring on index.html: ensure the click binding survives bootApp()/HTMX swaps and is not occluded by the 'Connect to a tenant' modal backdrop (close modal first or raise the top-bar z-index above the modal). Recommend onclick="vk.logout()" inline or delegate via document.addEventListener('click', e => e.target.closest('[data-testid=logout-btn]') && vk.logout()).
Cosmetic: switch from cdn.tailwindcss.com to a built CSS bundle for the Spring static resources (Tailwind itself warns).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 891 lines but is an intentionally cohesive mock with extensive seed/validation/CRUD; splitting is optional. No MongoDB _id leaks (in-memory).

JWT 'mock' is opaque: signature is the literal string b64('mock-signature'). For the preview that's fine since SafeBearerTokenAuthenticationConverter only checks the 3-segment shape, but be aware the mock will accept ANY string with 2 dots as a valid token after b64 decode. Acceptable for preview, but documented.
_require_auth/_require_admin are stub guards — they do not verify token expiry (`exp` claim) or signature. Confirm the Java SafeBearerTokenAuthenticationConverter is the source of truth in prod.
ADMIN_USERS / ADMIN_TENANTS are module-level in-memory dicts — state is lost on backend restart (already called out in mocked_api note).
tools_convert_csv decodes with errors='replace' which silently masks encoding bugs; acceptable for preview.
ToolsController DMN parser is XML-only; safe given ET parses untrusted XML — consider defusedxml in the Java side for production.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST tenants 'acme', 'qa' and user 'alice_test' via the UI flow. All persist only in the FastAPI process memory; restart clears them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend mock at /app/backend/server.py is fully green. Re-test only the logout-btn flow after main agent fixes index.html wiring. JWT 'Missing dot delimiter(s)' bug fix is covered structurally: /api/v1/auth/login returns tokens with exactly 2 dots and 3 non-empty base64url segments (test_auth_login_admin_ok asserts this). The Java SafeBearerTokenAuthenticationConverterTest cannot be executed here (no JVM in pod) — covered by code review only.
rca_of_the_issue: Logout regression — RCA: After admin login + visit /, bootApp() in index.html opens the 'Connect to a tenant' modal automatically (no tenant context configured yet). The modal backdrop seems to be on the same/higher z-index as the top-bar, so logout-btn click events do not reach the handler (or the handler is bound to a stale node that bootApp() replaced). Reproduction: 1) login admin/admin → admin.html. 2) navigate to /. 3) see modal. 4) click logout-btn (top-right). Observe: vk.auth.v1 in localStorage unchanged, URL still /. Mitigation: close/dismiss modal automatically when clicking logout, OR bind via document-level delegated listener, OR add inline onclick="event.preventDefault(); vk.logout()" to the logout button markup.
